# SvelteForge

A SvelteKit addon that provides a complete UI component library and starter templates built on Skeleton UI v4 and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Templates

### Base
UI-only starter with components, theme, and layouts. No auth, no database.

### Dashboard
Base + auth (Better Auth), database (Drizzle + SQLite), and admin dashboard.

## Install

```bash
# Create a new project with SvelteForge (one-liner)
npx sv create my-app --template minimal --types ts --add '@ludoloops/svelteforge=template:base' --install bun
cd my-app
bun dev
```

Or step by step:
```bash
npx sv create my-app --template minimal --types ts
cd my-app
npx sv add @ludoloops/svelteforge
```

The addon prompts for a template:
- **Base** — UI components + theme + layouts
- **Dashboard** — Base + Better Auth + Drizzle SQLite + admin dashboard

## Quick Start — Base

After installation, you get:

- **15 UI components** — Button, Card, Badge, Avatar, Alert, Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Toggle, ThemeToggle, Accordion, Tabs, Table, Breadcrumb
- **2 layout components** — Navbar (responsive), Footer
- **SvelteForge theme** — custom oklch color palette
- **Tailwind v4 custom utilities** — spacing, radius, and width tokens via `@theme`
- **Demo page** at `/demo-ui` showcasing all components

## Quick Start — Dashboard

Everything from Base, plus:

- **Better Auth** — email/password login, session management, protected routes
- **Drizzle + SQLite** — schema auto-generated, `drizzle-kit push` to create tables
- **Admin dashboard** `/admin` — stats cards, user CRUD, settings
- **Auth guard** — unprotected routes redirect to `/login`

### Dashboard setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env    # DATABASE_URL, ORIGIN, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
npx drizzle-kit push    # Create database tables
bun dev                 # Start dev server
# Visit /login and sign up — first user is admin
```

## Components

All components use `cn()` (clsx + tailwind-merge) and accept a `class` prop:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Card, Badge } from '$lib/components/ui';
</script>

<Button variant="filled" color="primary" size="lg">
  Get Started
</Button>

<Button variant="gradient" color="primary">
  Gradient
</Button>

<Button variant="glass" color="secondary">
  Glass
</Button>

<Button loading={saving}>
  Saving...
</Button>

<Button href="/about">
  Link Button
</Button>

<Badge variant="tonal" color="success">Active</Badge>

<Card variant="elevated">
  <h2>Hello World</h2>
</Card>
```

### Button

Variants: `filled` · `outlined` · `tonal` · `ghost` · `glass` · `elevated` · `gradient`
Colors: `primary` · `secondary` · `tertiary` · `success` · `warning` · `error` · `surface`
Sizes: `sm` · `md` · `lg`
Props: `loading`, `disabled`, `href` (renders `<a>`), `type`, `icon`

### Badge

Variants: `filled` · `outlined` · `tonal`
Colors: `primary` · `secondary` · `tertiary` · `success` · `warning` · `error` · `surface`
Sizes: `sm` · `md` · `lg`

### Card

Variants: `flat` (default) · `elevated` (shadow) · `outlined` (ring)

### Alert

Variants: `info` · `success` · `warning` · `error`
Uses Skeleton `preset-tonal-*` classes.

## Theming

Colors are defined as oklch CSS variables in `src/lib/styles/svelteforge-theme.css`. The theme is split into three files:

```
src/lib/styles/
├── index.css              ← barrel (imports tokens + theme)
├── tokens.css             ← @theme block: fonts, spacing, radius, widths
└── svelteforge-theme.css  ← [data-theme='svelteForge'] with oklch colors
```

Custom Tailwind utilities via `@theme`:
- `p-section` / `p-group` / `p-element` — spacing
- `rounded-card` / `rounded-modal` — radius
- `max-w-modal` / `max-w-toast` / `max-w-container` — widths

## Architecture

```
templates/
├── base/              # UI components + theme + layouts
│   └── src/
│       ├── lib/components/ui/      # 15 components
│       ├── lib/components/layout/  # Navbar, Footer
│       ├── lib/styles/             # theme + tokens
│       └── routes/layout.css       # CSS imports
└── dashboard/         # Overlay on base (only changed files)
    └── src/
        ├── lib/server/auth.ts      # Better Auth config
        ├── lib/server/db/          # Drizzle schema
        ├── routes/login/           # Login page
        └── routes/(app)/admin/     # Dashboard, Users, Settings
```

The dashboard template only contains files that differ from base. The build system merges them automatically.

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Framework | SvelteKit 2.x + Svelte 5.x (runes) |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 + Skeleton UI v4 |
| Auth | Better Auth v1.x |
| Database | Drizzle ORM + libsql (SQLite) |
| Icons | Phosphor Icons |
| Build | Vite 8.x |

## Development

```bash
bun install
bun run build                              # prebuild + tsdown
bun scripts/test-local.ts base /tmp/test   # local test (base)
bun scripts/test-local.ts dashboard /tmp/test  # local test (dashboard)
cd /tmp/test && bun install && bun dev
```
